sharedEditsNeeded: A join output frame-rate hook on the descriptor (for example outputFrameRate(step, inputRates)) read by activation/plan.ts, activation/actors.ts and the frame-graph/stream clocks (videoGraphClocks), so maskedclamp can use the base input rate as native config_output does (ol->frame_rate = il->frame_rate) instead of the vf_stack equal-or-1/0 rule; alternatively a hook to refuse unequal input rates at plan time. Without it unequal-rate inputs diverge silently.

tests/helpers/video-negotiation-cases.ts: nativeNegotiationOutcome always runs the linear path, so it cannot serve join operators; a paths filter (or a join-aware variant) would let joins reuse it. This branch mirrors it inline for graph/stream/actor/timed.
notes: Status partial only because unequal input frame rates diverge without an explicit refusal; equal-rate inputs are byte-exact on all four join paths.

Spec [FS-OPTS] says accept shortest, but native maskedclamp uses AVFILTER_DEFINE_CLASS (no framesync options): shortest, eof_action, repeatlast and ts_sync_mode fail natively with Option not found (exit 8). They are refused here to match native; the step always carries shortest:false.
EdgeFFmpeg CLI failures exit 1; native statuses are pinned from os.constants.errno on the host.
Native creates its output file before failing on a size mismatch; EdgeFFmpeg opens none.

Setup: npm run bootstrap failed in 0.4s (Node.js 24+ is required; installing Node 24 via npx n was denied by the sandbox permission policy), so the documented fallback ran: git submodule update + npm ci + npm run reference:build took 4m08s in total. Baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 1m28s (all passing); baseline registry test passed. Differential file ~6s; unit+registry ~2s.
